name: Pointe Coupee Power Station gas supply pipeline (Entergy Louisiana, Big Cajun site)
monitor_reason: No pipeline builder or operator is named, and no concrete step is shown (no FERC filing, open season, permit, contract or route). Add-threshold legs (a) sponsor and (c) concrete step are not met. Pipeline length, route and capacity are also not public.
researcher_notes: Not a match to any existing row. No row serves Pointe Coupee Parish or the Big Cajun site. Two Louisiana Public Service Commission documents in the Meta docket U-37882 load and name Pointe Coupee. One is Entergy Louisiana testimony that mentions pipeline costs and arrangements. The other places the three units near the Big Cajun site and records intervenor questions on whether a new gas pipeline for the units needs Natural Gas Act approval. Neither names who would build it, where it would run, or how long it would be. Earlier searches of the federal pipeline projects workbook, FERC filings and press found nothing. The Energy Transfer supply deal in the same docket is tied to other units. The data center link is Meta, but no source ties the pipeline itself to a stated route or builder, so the data center flag stays blank. Revisit if a FERC prefiling, a state permit or a named builder appears. Confidence is low.
